results.description:
Dani Price doesn't believe in friendship do-overs or second chances in love, especially when it comes to Jason Graywolf. He betrayed their friendship and unwittingly broke her heart, landing him on her never again list. One her resolve falters, she discovers a night in Jason's arms is not just an itch to be scratched.

Jason Graywolf regrets the mistake of his life, losing Dani. In a single instance he lets misplaced loyalty and jealousy cost him the woman he loves. The night she willingly spent in his arms offered a glimmer of hope. He was wrong.
 
When their matchmaking mothers take control, Jason and Dani find themselves in the same place, at the same time, and with only one hotel room. For Dani, at least there's two beds. For Jason, there's only once chance in the game of love, and he's playing to win.
